common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Capability Jump
common.line: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated.

common.title: Defensive Breakthrough
common.line: Defensive tooling closes the gap for a whole class of attack – automated patching at the speed vulnerabilities are found, or detection that catches swarm behaviour rather than signatures – and the offence-defence balance visibly shifts back for the first time in years.

common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Medical corridor carveout
notable.line: US and China agree a limited non-belligerency carve-out for medical reagents, sequencing kits and clinical cloud capacity transiting to neutral Europe, easing wartime throttling of tailored therapies.

notable.title: Neutral cable repair
notable.line: Neutral-flag undersea cable repair consortium led by non-belligerent states restores partial Atlantic and Mediterranean redundancy, temporarily easing European registry and data-centre outages despite ongoing US-China strikes.
